role: Keeps the work organised, saved and on track. Silent unless something is genuinely slipping — a day with nothing to say is a day it did its job.

speak.what: 15 hand-written file(s) changed and not committed.
speak.why: Generated artifacts churn constantly and that is fine. Hand-written work sitting uncommitted is a session's thinking one crash away from gone.
Problems that stay open stop being read. If they are not going to be fixed, they should be closed with a reason instead of carried.
A stage that stopped running is invisible to every guard, because none of them run either. Silence is the one failure nothing else catches.

speak.what: 20 script(s) are not referenced anywhere: artifact-freshness.mjs, backfill-artists.mjs, build-faq.mjs, build-hooks.mjs.
speak.why: A script nothing calls is either dead or was wired up and quietly unwired. Both are worth knowing, and neither announces itself.
A directory nobody can scan is a directory where something goes missing without being noticed.
